Reference

Arena and legion war

The rules the two competitive modes actually run on: who the arena offers you, what a win is worth, what each rank pays daily and per season; and the legion war's weekly clock, its rating tiers, strongholds and payouts. Everything here is the config table, with item names from the localisation.

Arena

Who you are offered

arena_match_strategy picks opponents by your current rank, drawing from the rules in arena_match_rule. "Above" is a better rank than yours.

arena_score_ratio: the score you take from a win, as a share of the base, by the rank of the opponent you beat. Beating the top pays 95%; below rank 5,000 it pays nothing.

The guards

When the ladder has no player to offer, the arena fields a template guard: 500 templates across Knight (100), Duelist (100), Sorcerer (100), Sage (100), Warrior (50), Mage (50), levels 1–100, promotions No Rank to Champion I. Each carries a fixed loadout of Techniques and Charms at its level.

Legion war

The weekly clock

legion_fight_period runs three groups a week. Sign-up lasts a day, matching an hour and a half, the battle twelve hours, then a truce until the next sign-up.

  • Group 1: SignUp Sunday 08:30 (24h) → Match Monday 08:30 (90 min) → Start Monday 10:00 (12h) → End Monday 22:00 (630 min)
  • Group 2: SignUp Tuesday 08:30 (24h) → Match Wednesday 08:30 (90 min) → Start Wednesday 10:00 (12h) → End Wednesday 22:00 (630 min)
  • Group 3: SignUp Thursday 08:30 (24h) → Match Friday 08:30 (90 min) → Start Friday 10:00 (12h) → End Friday 22:00 (2070 min)

Rating tiers

legion_fight_rank_score: the score band of each tier, the Elo step a result moves you by, the extra loss offset, where a new season resets you, and what a win or a loss pays. The tier keys are the config's own; the promotion names apply to the first six, the rest have no separate name in the localisation.

Purrwikimania — an independent, fan-made reference for Sword x Staff (Boltray Games). Every number here is read directly out of the game's own configuration files and decompiled code, not from testing or estimation. Item names are the game's official English strings.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Boltray Games. Game names, images and data are the property of their owners. Figures reflect the client build they were extracted from and can change with any patch — see Method for exactly what was read and when.
